title: Scientific Constants (CONST)
summary: Forty fundamental constants in ROM, recalled with SHIFT 7 (CONST), then page ◀/▶ and a key 1–4.

body.text: Press SHIFT 7 (CONST) to open page 1 of the constant menu (10 pages, four symbols each). Use ◀ / ▶ to reach the page you need, then press 1–4. This is not a two-digit 01–40 index. Constants work in every mode except BASE.

items: In COMP you can also combine h (2-2) and c (7-4) as E = hc/λ; keep λ in metres

body.label: Full table
body.text: The official fx-50FH / fx-50F family manuals list all 40 entries as page-key pairs (1-1 through 10-4). Treat ROM values as authoritative over printed approximations when checking calculator output.
